body.statement: At \(C=1\), \(d_e=d_b\), the immediate estimator \(\widehat\theta_0\) has cardinality-uniform mean-squared error of order \(T^{-1}\), and \(R_T(t_0,\zeta,1)\asymp T^{-1}\). Consequently the fixed-\(C>1\) theorem has a genuine discontinuous boundary in exponent, although its constants need not be uniform as \(C\downarrow1\).
body.justification: The equality boundary is the required sanity reduction and reveals that an arbitrarily small fixed latent shift is asymptotically consequential over the unrestricted finite-state union.
body.gap: MehrabiWager2025 gives the fully observed strong-overlap endpoint, while neither it nor HuWager2023 isolates the exact \(C=1\) latent stationary-law equality boundary for the present observed experiment.
body.consumer: This tells investigators when a genuine stationary-law invariance claim, stronger than mere bounded overlap, permits immediate weighting.
